_source: Copied from the Obsidian vault: Personal/Lao/Lao L2 HW 2.md (question exercises) and Personal/Lao/Lao.md (coffee shop and fruits). ກໍາ/ຕໍາ typed as ໍ + າ in the notes are normalized to ຳ.

items.lao: ເຈົ້າມີອ້າຍຈັກຄົນ?
items.en: How many older brothers do you have?

items.lao: ເຈົ້າເກີດວັນທີເທົ່າໃດ?
ເຈົ້າກຳລັງໄປໃສ?
items.en: Where are you going right now?

items.lao: ເຈົ້າມັກກິນຕຳໝາກຫຸ່ງແນວໃດ?
items.roman: jao mak kin tam maak hoong naew dai?
items.en: How do you like your papaya salad?

items.lao: ນີ້ແມ່ນປຶ້ມຂອງໃຜ?
ເຮັດແກງໜໍ່ໄມ້ແນວໃດ?
items.roman: hed kaeng noh mai naew dai?
items.en: How do you make bamboo shoot soup?

items.lao: ເຈົ້າຢາກຊື້ເສື້ອໂຕໃດ?
items.roman: jao yaak seu seuaa toh dai?
items.en: Which shirt do you want to buy?

items.lao: ເຈົ້າເຮັດວຽກກັບໃຜ?
ວັນເສົາໜ້າ, ເຈົ້າຊິຮຽນພາສາລາວຢູ່ໃສ?
items.roman: van sao naa, jao see hian phaasaa lao yoo sai?
items.en: Next Saturday, where will you study Lao?

items.lao: ມື້ອື່ນ, ພວກເຈົ້າຊິເຮັດຫຍັງຢູ່ບ້ານ?
items.roman: meu eun, phooak jao see hed nyang yoo baan?
items.en: What will you all do at home tomorrow?

items.lao: ປີໜ້າ, ລາວຊິອາຍຸຈັກປີ?
items.roman: pee naa, lao see ayu jak pee?
items.en: How old will they be next year?

items.lao: ມື້ວານນີ້, ເຈົ້າໄດ້ໄປຕະຫຼາດກັບໃຜ?
items.roman: meuvaan nee, jao dai pai talaad kab phai?
items.en: Who did you go to the market with yesterday?

items.lao: ເຈົ້າກິນເຂົ້າແລງແລ້ວບໍ?
items.roman: jao kin khao laeng leo boh?

items.lao: ວັນຈັນກ່ອນ, ເຈົ້າໄດ້ຕື່ນຈັກໂມງ?
items.roman: van chan kohn, jao dai teun jak mong?
items.en: What time did you wake up last Monday?

items.lao: ເກີບອີແຕະນີ້ລາຄາເທົ່າໃດ?
items.roman: kuhb ee tae nee laakhaa thao dai?
items.en: How much do these flip-flops cost?

items.lao: ເຈົ້າຊິໄປປະເທດລາວເວລາໃດ?
items.roman: jao see pai pathed lao vela dai?
items.en: When will you go to Laos?

items.lao: ຂ້ອຍຂໍສັ່ງໂມຄາເຢັນສອງຈອກໄດ້ບໍ?
items.roman: khoi khoh sang mocha yen song jok dai boh?
items.en: Can I please order two iced mochas?

items.lao: ເອົາໂມຄາເຢັນສອງ
ເອົາຈອກໃຫຍ່

items.en: How much is it in total?
